    # Build lookup structures
    node_by_id = {n["id"]: n for n in nodes}
    
    # Get path from node to root
    def ancestors(node_id):

        while current is not None:
            path.append(current)
            parent = node_by_id[current]["parent"]
            current = parent
        return path
    
    # Start with all non-removable nodes
    kept = set()
    for node in nodes:
        if not node["removable"]:
            # Must keep this node and all its ancestors
            for anc in ancestors(node["id"]):
                kept.add(anc)
    
    # Check which required symbols are already covered
    covered_symbols = {node_by_id[nid]["symbol"] for nid in kept}
    
    # For uncovered required symbols, find best removable node to add

            if candidates:
                # Pick highest utility
                best = max(candidates, key=lambda n: n["utility"])
                for anc in ancestors(best["id"]):
                    kept.add(anc)
                covered_symbols.add(symbol)
    
    # Return sorted list of kept node IDs
    return sorted(kept)
```

def solve(case):
    nodes = case["nodes"]
    required_symbols = set(case["required_symbols"])
    
    # Build lookup
    node_by_id = {n["id"]: n for n in nodes}
    
    def get_ancestors(node_id):
        """Return list of node_ids from given node up to root (inclusive)."""
        path = []
        current = node_id
        while current is not None:
            path.append(current)
            current = node_by_id[current]["parent"]
        return path
    
    # Keep all non-removable nodes and their ancestor paths
    kept = set()
    for node in nodes:
        if not node["removable"]:
            for anc_id in get_ancestors(node["id"]):
                kept.add(anc_id)
    
    # Determine which required symbols are already covered
    covered = {node_by_id[nid]["symbol"] for nid in kept}
    
    # For each uncovered required symbol, pick the highest-utility removable node
    for symbol in required_symbols:
        if symbol not in covered:
            candidates = [
                n for n in nodes
                if n["symbol"] == symbol and n["removable"]
            ]
            if candidates:
                best = max(candidates, key=lambda n: n["utility"])
                for anc_id in get_ancestors(best["id"]):
                    kept.add(anc_id)
                covered.add(symbol)
    
    return {"kept_nodes": sorted(kept)}
```
